prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve / focused pixel-art portrait revision.
Input image 1 is your first-pass portrait EDIT TARGET. Input image 2 is the selected original identity master only. Inputs 3–6 are style-only references. Preserve the first-pass person, gender, age and essential color identity, and redraw only the issues below. The target deliverable is a single 74 x 100 pixel medieval RPG dialogue head: very large face, very short neck, true transparent background. Coarse hard-edged broad flat connected pixel clusters, intentional stepped contours, temporary palette at most 32 muted colors, no antialiasing, gradients or dithering. No text, border, props or extra people.
Make a focused second pass of THIS SAME thirty-something Milei face. Preserve her brown tightly gathered compact bun, longish oval adult face, straight medium nose, brown dress edge and faded gray-blue coastal shawl. Correct the drawing, do not just crop or scale the first image. Pull ALL long dangling curled side locks back into the tight compact bun; no ringlets dangling beside cheeks/neck, only two simple broad short temple wedges. Reduce hair shading into four broad masses without little parallel streaks. Eliminate the central V brow and raised inner ends; make two almost HORIZONTAL calm eyebrows, small DARK NARROW side-looking eyes with barely a subdued tan-gray sclera sliver, no big white rectangles or bright dot in pupils. Expression is quiet resolute patience and self-possession, firm horizontal closed mouth, not sorrow or fear. Her small tired lower-eye shadow is subtle; do not add an older woman's deep folds. Shorten exposed neck dramatically so jaw nearly meets shawl; gray-blue shawl is only a thin lower-edge collar strip at bottom 5–7%, no shoulder arcs or chest. Large face, all bun and ears contained with 2 target pixel transparent side margins and 3 pixels above. No clipping on any edge. Keep her 30s and distinct from broad older Risha.
This is the only revision. No story outcomes. Genuine transparency. The final NN/alpha/palette derivation will be disclosed as a derivative, not native pixel authorship.
